# JoyVoice: AI Floating Mic Dictation & Speech Translation for Windows

> Current version: 2.6.0 (https://github.com/MHJoy99/joyvoice/releases/tag/v2.6.0)
>
> JoyVoice is an open-source, low-latency floating microphone dictation and real-time speech translation application for Windows 10/11. It has three engines: Cloud (default; Google Web Speech plus a Gemini text model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, with optional native audio through the `joyvoice-fast-audio` alias when `JV_NATIVE_AUDIO=true`), ElevenLabs instant (opt-in since v2.6.0; streams audio while you speak to ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime and Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live; Bengali is translated from Gemini's complete transcript by a fast text model in about 1 s), and Free & Offline (local faster-whisper). Press F8, speak in any of 10 languages, and automatically paste clean translated text into any active Windows application.

## Overview & Purpose

JoyVoice solves the friction of cross-application multilingual typing and voice dictation. Unlike heavy local Whisper models requiring expensive GPUs or built-in OS dictation tools restricted to single languages, JoyVoice provides a lightweight, cloud-accelerated dictation pipeline packaged inside a sleek glass-morphism desktop widget.

### Key Highlights
- **ElevenLabs instant engine (v2.6.0, opt-in):** English speech is pasted 0.41-0.56 s after hotkey release; Bengali or mixed Bengali-English speech is pasted as English about 1 s after release with a fast translator key (measured 0.92-1.2 s; a 30 s fast clip 1.44 s; 2.3-3.5 s with the gateway alone). Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live (`gemini-3.5-transcribe-live`, `bn-BD`, custom vocabulary) finalizes the complete transcript 0.3-0.6 s after release (`audioStreamEnd` then `generationComplete`), and a fast OpenAI-compatible translator (default Groq `openai/gpt-oss-120b`) races the gateway text model, so endings are not cut off and wording is not paraphrased. Romanized Banglish is detected, so mixed speech is never mistaken for English. `JV_BENGALI_EAR=translate` restores the older Gemini Live Translate ear. Backups: Gemini's live English (only if it covers every sentence), ElevenLabs translation, Cloud engine. Needs your own ElevenLabs API key and a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio; the fast translator key is optional. Any failure falls back to the Cloud engine.
- **GPU glass widget (v2.6.0):** aurora-palette floating pill drawn with moderngl shaders on NVIDIA (Ultra/High/Balanced/Calm/Off, fps cap 30/60/120, falls back to Balanced if OpenGL fails; about 180-200 MB of memory on Ultra). Settings → Appearance has a live preview for colours, themes, motion, size, glass and accessibility (high contrast, colour-blind palette, reduce motion, screen-reader names, 44 px targets).
- **Zero Local GPU Overhead:** Runs effortlessly on integrated graphics in default cloud mode; all ASR and neural translation execute via cloud API.
- **Native audio gateway:** Optional `joyvoice-fast-audio` sends one mono 16-bit 16 kHz WAV request containing transcript, English translation, and `target_override`.
- **Cloud ASR + Gemini AI:** Uses Google Web Speech as fallback and Gemini 3.6 Flash for text translation and intelligent text styling.
- **Automatic Language Detection:** Speak naturally in any supported language without manual toggle; JoyVoice identifies the source language instantly.
- **Direct Typing and Clipboard-Safe Paste:** Single-line results are typed into the focused window with SendInput Unicode (no clipboard, no Ctrl). Multi-line text uses `Ctrl+V` with retry and clipboard preservation. Optional Enter after paste, only in listed apps (off by default).
- **Opt-in Free & Offline Mode:** Supports local faster-whisper dictation without requiring cloud APIs when enabled.

---

## Direct Execution Guide (Run from this Folder)

To run JoyVoice directly from the repository root:

1. **Environment Setup:** Ensure Python 3.11 is installed.
2. **Virtual Environment:**
   ```cmd
   python -m venv .venv
   .venv\Scripts\activate
   ```
3. **Install Dependencies:**
   ```cmd
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```
4. **Configure API Key:**
   ```cmd
   set JV_API_KEY=your_bdx_market_api_key
   ```
5. **Launch Application:**
   ```cmd
   run.bat
   ```
   *Alternatively, execute directly via Python:*
   ```cmd
   .venv\Scripts\python app\main.py
   ```

---

## Supported Languages

- **Bangla (`bn`)** - বাংলা (Bangladeshi Bengali with code-switching support)
- **English (`en`)** - English (US/UK)
- **Russian (`ru`)** - Русский
- **Hindi (`hi`)** - हिन्दी
- **Spanish (`es`)** - Español
- **Arabic (`ar`)** - العربية
- **Chinese (`zh`)** - 中文 (Mandarin)
- **Japanese (`ja`)** - 日本語
- **French (`fr`)** - Français
- **Portuguese (`pt`)** - Português

## System Architecture Summary

```
Microphone (16 kHz float32)
   └── Cloud ASR (Google Web Speech API) -> Spoken Transcript
       └── Gemini 3.6 Flash Text API -> Target Translation / Style Rewrite
           └── Rule-based Text Cleaner (text_cleaner.py)
               └── History Store Persistence (%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\history.json)
                   └── Clipboard Safe Auto-Paste (Ctrl+V with retry x3)
```

---

## Technical Specifications

- **OS Compatibility:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (Win32 APIs for global hotkeys & clipboard automation)
- **Python Version:** Python 3.11.9
- **GUI Framework:** PySide6 (Qt 6.7+)
- **Audio Capture:** sounddevice (WASAPI PortAudio)
- **Settings Store:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\settings.json`
- **History Store:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\history.json`
- **Log File:** `%APPDATA%\JoyVoice\joyvoice.log`
